businesses.business: engineered industrial components and flow equipment

offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures highly engineered critical components and flow-control equipment for transportation, industrial and energy customers. Products include pumps, valves, brake pads, shock absorbers, connectors and sealing components. Sells mainly to OEMs, industrial operators and aftermarket channels.

primary_products.value: industrial pumps; valves and flow control equipment; brake pads and friction components; shock absorbers and energy absorption devices; electrical connectors

customer_segment.value: B2B: automotive, rail and aerospace OEMs, chemical, oil and gas, mining and water operators, industrial distributors; B2G: defense and public transit or municipal water customers

end_markets.value: automotive; rail and transit; aerospace and defense; chemical processing; oil and gas; industrial and water

revenue_model.value: product sales: pumps, valves, friction parts, connectors and shock absorbers sold to OEMs and aftermarket; service fees: aftermarket service, repair and replacement parts for installed equipment

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: manufactures engineered components and pumps from metals and materials, sold to OEMs and industrial users; component supplier: supplies friction, connector and motion control parts to vehicle and equipment makers

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe and Asia, with plants across many countries

specialization.value: related lines: Motion Technologies, Industrial Process and Connect & Control Technologies engineered component lines

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: OEMs and large industrial and process customers; distributors / dealers: industrial distributors and aftermarket parts channels

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Product safety, environmental and trade rules, automotive and aerospace quality standards, export controls

notes: Segment structure and recent divestitures/acquisitions may have changed details.
